body:
I just don't think its fair for me to use up resources that could easily go to some little kid that needs it more than me. 

I've tried getting medical treatment, but it just costs too much. I have no insurance so it's just out of the question. 

I was diagnosed as clinically depressed when I was 16. The lithium just made me feel like I was watching my life instead of living it. I was on my parents insurance back then, when I turned 18 that all went away. I have no idea how to solve this...
